author: Robin_DD_J
body:
"THIS MAP IS FOR TOURNAMENT ONLY" --- "THIS MAP IS NOT DONE AND FEEDABCK IS ALL I NEED" --- "KTHANKSBYE"
Name: Kompis
Amout of players: This is a "Tournament" map, which means it can be between 7-15 players.
Type: DTM (Destory the Monument)
YML: http://pastebin.com/3nkLqCyS ( Thanks to Sli and Zintenka! )
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/x4q6nnb35n7s7jk/Robin2.rar (Thank you Alex)
Helpers: None
What makes this map special: This map is, and should only be for "Tournament". There is a limited amout of Diamond blocks (3 Blocks) and a limited amout of Iron blocks (14 Blocks) which means you need to take care of armor, be carefull with it. In the middle of the map there is a small island (Picture bellow) with "64" tnt and other godies like wood, and stuff to make cannons. I've put this here to make the 2 teams having a fight over the supplies that is in the chest, it will help both defenders and frontliners.
Random facts: 

More pictures here: 
http://imgur.com/xdwX2Nl,AxuHCr1,8XpP3eG,A29rJht#0
